name: tomc-memory
description: Prepare external task evidence and optional notebooks; the host manages active-chat compaction.
long_description: TOMC prepares supplied task evidence on CPU, with optional named notebooks and a local context library. Successful prepared context and its task are saved by default; local recording can be disabled independently of processing. The original input is not separately archived, but short inputs may remain intact in prepared context. Context snapshots support portable export and continuation prompts. Numeric context-reduction estimates are separate from saved text and are not API or billing savings. The host owns active-chat compaction; this MCP server does not replace the host's full request history. Optional metadata-only session hooks support default-on processing and persistent per-session pause; installation, host loading and hook trust are required. The first installation needs network access for the runtime and dependencies. Use get_status for configuration and get_usage_stats for context estimates.

tools.name: prepare_context
tools.description: Prepare supplied history for the next task; save the prepared context when local recording is enabled. Budget covers estimated memory tokens.

tools.name: remember_memory
tools.description: Optionally save user-supplied history in a named notebook.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Prepare an optional notebook's history for the next task.

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.description: Delete a specified notebook when requested.

tools.name: get_usage_stats
tools.description: View local cumulative estimated context reduction for all, today, or 7d (UTC), not API or billing savings.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Inspect configuration, processing settings and declared session state; configuration is not runtime verification.

tools.name: list_contexts
tools.description: List saved prepared-context snapshots without their body.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Read one selected context snapshot as historical evidence.

tools.name: make_handoff
tools.description: Build a self-contained continuation prompt; does not send it.
